title: Links and Images
prompt:
Build a small page with a link and two images so you can see how alt text works.

  • Add a link (<a>) whose href is https://www.w3.org/ and whose visible text is W3C.
  • Add a working image with src="cat-v1.png" and alt of A friendly cat. This file is provided with the assignment and should display in the preview.
  • Add a second image with src="missing-cat.jpg" and alt of Cat photo unavailable. That file does not exist — after you Run, you should see the alt text in the preview (and a failed-load message in the Console).

html.starter:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Links and Images</title>
</head>
<body>
  <!-- Add your link and two images here -->

</body>
</html>

tests.name: Link points to W3C
tests.feedback: Set the link href to https://www.w3.org/

tests.name: Link text is W3C
tests.feedback: The visible link text should be W3C.

tests.name: Has two images
tests.feedback: Add exactly two elements (one that loads, one that does not).

tests.name: Working image has alt text
tests.feedback: Set alt="A friendly cat" on the cat-v1.png image.

tests.name: Missing image points at a non-existent file
Missing image has fallback alt text
tests.feedback: Set alt="Cat photo unavailable" on the missing-cat.jpg image.

solution.html: W3C
